_notice: FICTIONAL. Scope change log for Orrinwick Beacon. Each entry records the evaluation of a change to mas/mas-record.json (rule SCN-CSO-MAR) and a fingerprint of the scope after it. tools/check_scope_changes.py fails when the record changes without a new entry. Add entries in date order.
